local data={
	-- Functionals
	["Aerospace Material I"]={name="Aerospace Material I", tier=3, use="A basic construction material. Can be used to upgrade Dijiang.", desc="Only use these materials within the effective range of Protocol facilities.", obtain="Acquired from the Recycling Station., Recycling Station"},
	["Aerospace Material II"]={name="Aerospace Material II", tier=4, use="An advanced industrial construction material. Can be used to upgrade Dijiang.", desc="If this material exhibits any sign of warping or discoloration, IMMEDIATELY CONTACT the Endministrator or Supervisor Perlica.", obtain="Acquired from the Recycling Station., Recycling Station"},
	-----AIC Index-----
	["Basic AIC Index"]={name="Basic AIC Index", tier=4, use="These index points are required to research various AIC technologies in the Basic AIC Plan.", desc="A small electrical device that records AIC Factory performance in Valley IV. Connect it to the PAC to adjust Techno-Protocol deployment balance.", obtain="Basic AIC Plan tech research, Protocol Datalogger: Valley IV"},
	["Wuling AIC Index"]={name="Wuling AIC Index", tier=4, use="These index points are required to research various AIC technologies in the Wuling AIC Plan.", desc="A small electrical device that records AIC Factory performance in the Wuling region. Connect it to the Automation-Core to adjust Techno-Protocol deployment balance.", obtain="Wuling AIC Plan tech research, Protocol Datalogger: Wuling"},
	-----Operational EXP-----
	["Operational EXP"]={name="Operational EXP", tier=5, use="Raises the Endministrator's Authority Level.", desc="A form of experience you earn as you explore Talos-II. Like always, these lands await your discovery, Endministrator.", obtain="Reward: Operation Manual"},
	-----Daily Activity-----
	["Daily Activity"]={name="Daily Activity", tier=1, use="Earn enough of this to receive daily rewards.", desc="", obtain="Reward: Operation Manual"},
	-----Stamina Delimiter-----
	["Stamina Delimiter"]={name="Stamina Delimiter", tier=1, use="Once acquired, stamina limit for dodge/dash actions is permanently increased.", desc="The symbol of endurance. If necessary, this conceptual entity can become a brick. If things get even more desperate, life itself becomes a concept as well. The completion of our Tower is at hand.", obtain="Submit Aurylene at TP Points"},
	-----Outpost Prosperity-----
	["Outpost Prosperity"]={name="Outpost Prosperity", tier=4, use="Acquire enough outpost prosperity points to raise the level cap of the outpost.", desc="", obtain="Complete outpost orders, Reward: Outpost Orders"},
	-----Item Finders-----
	["Keen Valley Compass"]={name="Keen Valley Compass", tier=5, use="Consumable. Usage reveals an undiscovered Aurylene within the current area. Usable only after all fogged places of the map has been charted. This item only works in Valley IV.", desc="An Arts Unit for detecting Aurylene. This device looks like a compass, and contains a tiny Aurylene in its center to locate other Aurylene in the environment. This \"compass\" seems to be operating at an overclocked state. The needle would spin wildly upon simple activation.", obtain="Purchase: Valley IV Stock Redistribution, Stock Redistribution Terminal Upgrade"},
	["Keen Valley Detector"]={name="Keen Valley Detector", tier=5, use="Consumable. Usage reveals an undiscovered storage crate within the current area. Usable only after all fogged places of the map has been charted. This item only works in Valley IV.", desc="A special detector once created by prospectors looking for metal resources in Valley IV. It is made of the same metals used in storage crates. Using this points you to storage crates scattered throughout the area. Several words have been engraved along the edge of the device: \"To those who persevere in hopelessness.\"", obtain="Purchase: Valley IV Stock Redistribution, Stock Redistribution Terminal Upgrade"},
	["Keen Wuling Compass"]={name="Keen Wuling Compass", tier=5, use="Consumable. Usage reveals an undiscovered Aurylene within the current area. Usable only after all fogged places of the map has been charted. This item only works in Wuling.", desc="A positioning tool \"handcrafted\" by the residents of Qingbo Stockade. A few simple tweaks gave it the ability to detect Aurylene. Use with caution. The water within the device will start boiling violently as one approaches the item being detected.", obtain="Purchase: Wuling Stock Redistribution, Stock Redistribution Terminal Upgrade"},
	["Keen Wuling Detector"]={name="Keen Wuling Detector", tier=5, use="Consumable. Usage reveals an undiscovered storage crate within the current area. Usable only after all fogged places of the map has been charted. This item only works in Wuling.", desc="A small detector furnished with Xiranite technology, giving it the ability to accurately locate metallic objects. The detector can thus be used to locate storage crates. Fresh off the production line! Look how it shimmers!", obtain="Purchase: Wuling Stock Redistribution, Stock Redistribution Terminal Upgrade"},
	["Wuling Talosite Probe"]={name="Wuling Talosite Probe", tier=5, use="Consumable. Usage reveals an undiscovered Talosite within the current area. Usable only after all fogged places of the map have been charted. This item only works in Wuling.", desc="The sundial is used as an inspiration for designing this probe. It is capable of pinpointing energy fluctuations generated by moving Talosite.", obtain="Purchase: Wuling Stock Redistribution, Stock Redistribution Terminal Upgrade"},
	-----Development Metric-----
	["Valley Regional Development Metric"]={name="Valley Regional Development Metric", tier=5, use="Construction and development work in Valley IV will raise this development metric. This can raise the Regional Development Level to provide a generous reward.", desc="The mark of regional development in Valley IV. The proof of the hard work and sacrifices made by every contributor.", obtain="Investing in regional development, Reward: Valley IV Outpost Orders, Reward: Valley IV Pack and Deliver"},
	["Wuling Regional Development Metric"]={name="Wuling Regional Development Metric", tier=5, use="Construction and development work in Wuling will raise this development metric. This can raise the Regional Development Level to provide a generous reward.", desc="The mark of regional development in Wuling. The proof of the hard work and sacrifices made by every contributor.", obtain="Investing in regional development, Reward: Wuling Outpost Orders, Reward: Wuling Pack and Deliver, Reward: Environment Monitoring"},
	-----Combat Facilities Capacity-----
	["Combat Facilities Capacity"]={name="Combat Facilities Capacity", tier=5, use="Increases the number of combat facilities that can be placed for the outpost.", desc="", obtain="Reward: Area Defense"},
	-----Protocol Pass Experience-----
	["Pass Experience"]={name="Pass Experience", tier=5, use="Use this to level up the Protocol Pass.", desc="Every item on the Protocol Pass is gathered from official operator interviews conducted by the Arsenal Engineers. These items include support projects that everyone hopes to see.", obtain="Reward: Pass Missions"},
	-----Protocol Pass Tier-----
	["Pass Application: Originium"]={name="Pass Application: Originium", tier=6, use="Use this to activate the Protocol Pass tier: Originium Supply.", desc="Some Endfield operators enjoy referring to the Protocol Pass as their \"wishlist\". According to rumors, those who make a wish and place some Origeometry by their pillows during the eve of their birthdays will receive a satisfying reward from the kind little robots of the Arsenal.", obtain=""},
	["Access Pass Application: Customized"]={name="Access Pass Application: Customized", tier=6, use="Use this to activate the Protocol Pass tier: Protocol Customized.", desc="\"Good. Just sign your name here and you'll get your very own customized Protocol Pass... Oh? Efficiency? Don't worry. We'll airdrop the supplies to your place if necessary.\"", obtain=""},
	-----Weapon Potential Upgrade-----
	["Protocolized Weapon Pattern"]={name="Protocolized Weapon Pattern", tier=6, use="This can raise the potential of any weapon provided by Protocol Pass weapon supplies, including weapon supplies from future pass seasons. Go to the EFDB for details on applicable weapons.", desc="The Arsenal Engineers are always recording operator weapon preferences and other expectations they have... The Protocol Pass is an attempt used by the Arsenal to boost weapon R&D efficiency in Endfield.", obtain="Protocol Pass: Protocol Customized"},
	-----Monthly Pass-----
	["Monthly Pass Exchange Cert"]={name="Monthly Pass Exchange Cert", tier=6, use="Use this to get Monthly Pass perks for 30 days.", desc="Scan this with the Protosync and the Logistics Division will offer you tons of special perks, privileges, and services.", obtain=""},
	-----Wuling Area Buffs-----
	["Rested Offensive"]={name="Rested Offensive", tier=1, use="Resting at the TP Point gives a temporary ATK buff to all operators in the team. Only effective in Wuling.", desc="Collecting Aurylenes gave you a good understanding of the local region. You have learned the best places to rest and preserve your strength for another push.", obtain="Submit Aurylene at TP Points"},
	["Rested Defensive"]={name="Rested Defensive", tier=1, use="Resting at the TP Point gives a temporary DEF buff to all operators in the team. Only effective in Wuling.", desc="Collecting Aurylenes gave you a good understanding of the local region. You have learned the best places to consolidate your fortitude for holding these grounds.", obtain="Submit Aurylene at TP Points"},
	["Productive Hunting"]={name="Productive Hunting", tier=1, use="Defeated enemies have a chance to drop 1 more material. Only effective in Wuling.", desc="You have learned the local terrain, communities, traditions, and tactical intel. You now know the techniques to effectively acquire materials from local enemies.", obtain="Submit Aurylene at TP Points"},
	["Outdoors Expert"]={name="Outdoors Expert", tier=1, use="Gathering plants have a chance to give 1 more material (does not work for rare materials). Only effective in Wuling.", desc="Having searched high and low for Aurylenes, you now know every blade of grass and every lump of ore in this region. You have become an expert of the natural wilderness.", obtain="Submit Aurylene at TP Points"},
	["Medical Reserves"]={name="Medical Reserves", tier=1, use="After resting at a TP Point, acquire 1 stack of Medical Reserves buff. When any operator in the team drops below a certain HP, automatically consume the buff and immediately restores the HP of every teammate. Only effective in Wuling.", desc="You are always medically prepared, thanks to your familiarity with local intel", obtain="Submit Aurylene at TP Points"},
	["Full Vigor"]={name="Full Vigor", tier=1, use="Stamina regenerates faster. Only effective in Wuling.", desc="Scientific stamina management gives improved endurance recovery", obtain="Submit Aurylene at TP Points"},
	-----Trophies-----
	["Mr. Rammu"]={name="Mr. Rammu", tier=5, use="This can be showcased at the Tower of Trails at the Central Ring of Dijiang.", desc="A model of a cute critter. UWST crew mates treat long-ears as a bringer of courage as they are capable of surviving the dangerous environments of Talos-II.", obtain="Purchase: Valley IV Stock Redistribution, Stock Redistribution Terminal Upgrade"},
	["Arc 2000 Model"]={name="Arc 2000 Model", tier=5, use="This can be showcased at the Tower of Trails at the Central Ring of Dijiang.", desc="A scale model of a motorcycle. Arc 2000 is a classic and popular vehicle manufactured by Endfield Industries due to its light weight, reliability, and all-terrain performance. Even its scale models are widely sought after.", obtain="Purchase: Valley IV Stock Redistribution, Stock Redistribution Terminal Upgrade"},
	["Champion Drill Crawler"]={name="Champion Drill Crawler", tier=5, use="This can be showcased at the Tower of Trails at the Central Ring of Dijiang.", desc="A scale model of the multi-purpose drill. During the sudden Aggeloid attack when construction work first began at the Valley, this drill crawler carried out the crucial task of smashing the Ankhor to bits.", obtain="Purchase: Valley IV Stock Redistribution, Stock Redistribution Terminal Upgrade"},
	["Bonsai of Life"]={name="Bonsai of Life", tier=5, use="This can be showcased at the Tower of Trails at the Central Ring of Dijiang.", desc="A scale model of the Originium sapling. This is a gift, a blessing of growth, rebirth, and hope. It is usually placed at the side of a patient's bed.", obtain="Purchase: Valley IV Stock Redistribution, Stock Redistribution Terminal Upgrade"},
	["Tianshi Pillar Model"]={name="Tianshi Pillar Model", tier=5, use="This can be showcased at the Tower of Trails at the Central Ring of Dijiang.", desc="A standard Tianshi Pillar model. Switch it on and adjust to maximum brightness to use it as a large table lamp.", obtain="Purchase: Wuling Stock Redistribution, Stock Redistribution Terminal Upgrade"},
	["Qiming Station Model"]={name="Qiming Station Model", tier=5, use="This can be showcased at the Tower of Trails at the Central Ring of Dijiang.", desc="Fathomed in poems and dreams, fashioned with steel and labor... This pair of wings was sculpted to sail across the cosmos and pluck the stars from the very heavens.", obtain="Event: Snapshot: Etchings of Our Cosmic Dreams"},
	["Deluxe Chubby Lung"]={name="Deluxe Chubby Lung", tier=5, use="This can be showcased at the Tower of Trails at the Central Ring of Dijiang.", desc="An extra-large collector's edition Chubby Lung. Although it looks similar to the first batch of secret Chubby Lungs officially released by Wuling, this one is way bigger.", obtain="Purchase: Wuling Stock Redistribution, Stock Redistribution Terminal Upgrade"},
	["Companions Figurine"]={name="Companions Figurine", tier=5, use="This can be showcased at the Tower of Trails at the Central Ring of Dijiang.", desc="Two lovely visitors who traveled long and far together. They decided to leave their trails at this very place.", obtain="Event: Party Together"},
	["Dichromo-Light"]={name="Dichromo-Light", tier=5, use="This can be showcased at the Tower of Trails at the Central Ring of Dijiang.", desc="An intricate work whose designs have been inspired by the dichromolite. The contraption is actually a large puzzle. Successfully solving it will change its lights to green. If the puzzle remains unsolved, the lights stay red.", obtain="Purchase: Wuling Stock Redistribution, Stock Redistribution Terminal Upgrade"},
	["Mark and Fulfill"]={name="Mark and Fulfill", tier=5, use="This can be showcased at the Tower of Trails at the Central Ring of Dijiang.", desc="A commemorative model of the Wuling Marker Stone. Such stones are often used to expedite traveling to a certain place. Some residents of Wuling believe that placing a Marker Stone at home would give them a blessing of \"freedom\".", obtain="Purchase: Wuling Stock Redistribution, Stock Redistribution Terminal Upgrade"},
